items.key: Installed storage, reliable water access, water collected and commissioned solar.
items.english: Installed storage, reliable water access, water collected and commissioned solar.
items.draft: Indawo zokugcina ezifakiweyo, ufikelelo lwamanzi oluthembekileyo, amanzi aqokelelweyo nelanga elisebenzayo.
items.backtranslation: Installed storage places, reliable water access, harvested water and working solar.
items.problem: Wrong term: 'commissioned solar' became 'ilanga elisebenzayo' (the working sun); the indicator is about installed solar power.
items.corrected: Indawo zokugcina ezifakiweyo, ufikelelo lwamanzi oluthembekileyo, amanzi aqokelelweyo namandla elanga afakiweyo asebenzayo.

items.key: ImbewuField is a Progressive Web App — no app store, no download size. Open it once and add it to the home screen, and it opens like any other app from then on.
items.english: ImbewuField is a Progressive Web App — no app store, no download size. Open it once and add it to the home screen, and it opens like any other app from then on.
items.draft: I-ImbewuField yi-Progressive Web App — akukho stoko ye-app, akukho bukhulu bokukhuphela. Yivule kube kanye uyongeze kwiskrini sekhaya, kwaye ivuleka njengayo nayiphi enye i-app emva koko.
items.backtranslation: ImbewuField is a Progressive Web App — no app stock (store?), no download size. Open it once and add it to the home screen, and it opens like any other app after that.
items.problem: Wrong term: 'no app store' rendered as 'akukho stoko ye-app' (no app stock).
items.corrected: I-ImbewuField yi-Progressive Web App — akukho venkile ye-app, akukho bukhulu bokukhuphela. Yivule kube kanye uyongeze kwiskrini sekhaya, kwaye ivuleka njengayo nayiphi enye i-app emva koko.

items.key: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
items.english: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
items.draft: Amanzi okulima ayinqongophele. Jonga amanzi okusela ngokwahlukileyo; amanzi egadi akaqinisekisi ukubakho kwamanzi akhuselekileyo eenkukhu.
items.backtranslation: Farming water is [scarce / not scarce — form ambiguous]. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm the availability of safe water for chickens.
items.problem: Warning at risk of reversal: 'ayinqongophele' carries a negative-looking a- prefix with a wrong concord and reads as 'growing water is NOT scarce'; English says growing water is limited.
items.corrected: Amanzi okulima anqongophele. Jonga amanzi okusela ngokwahlukileyo; amanzi egadi akaqinisekisi ukubakho kwamanzi akhuselekileyo eenkukhu.

items.key: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried nuts in shell; no harvest from these example trees is claimed. Storage conditions, kernel weight and the amount held are not supplied.
items.english: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried nuts in shell; no harvest from these example trees is claimed. Storage conditions, kernel weight and the amount held are not supplied.
items.draft: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuAgasti ukuya kuOkthobha 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Ngamandongomane aqanjiweyo ethengiweyo okanye athwalwayo asegobolondweni; akukho sivuno sivela kwiimithi zomzekelo esicelwayo. Iimeko zokugcina, ubunzima bentliziyo yeqokobhe nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.
items.backtranslation: Invented/made-up storage months from August to October 2027, not a safe storage period. They are made-up peanuts (groundnuts) bought or carried in the shell; no harvest from the sample trees is claimed. Storage conditions, kernel weight and the stored quantity are not provided.
items.problem: Wrong food term: English 'nuts in shell' (from example trees) became 'amandongomane' (peanuts/groundnuts), a different crop.
items.corrected: Iinyanga zokugcina eziqanjiweyo ukusuka kuAgasti ukuya kuOkthobha 2027, hayi ixesha elikhuselekileyo lokugcina. Ngamantongomane aqanjiweyo ethengiweyo okanye athwalwayo asegobolondweni; akukho sivuno sivela kwiimithi zomzekelo esicelwayo. Iimeko zokugcina, ubunzima bentliziyo yeqokobhe nobungakanani obugciniweyo azinikezelwanga.

items.key: Choose a cool growing season and fertile, well-drained soil. Heat reduces bud quality and freezing can damage buds.
items.english: Choose a cool growing season and fertile, well-drained soil. Heat reduces bud quality and freezing can damage buds.
items.draft: Khetha ixesha lokukhula elibandayo nomhlaba ohlumileyo, ophuma kakuhle amanzi. Ubushushu buyehlisa umgangatho weentyatyambo ezingekavuleki kwaye iqabaka linokuzonakalisa.
items.backtranslation: Choose a cool growing season and "sprouted"(?fertile) well-draining soil. Heat lowers the quality of unopened flower heads and frost can damage them.
items.problem: Wrong word: 'fertile' soil rendered as 'ohlumileyo' (sprouted).
items.corrected: Khetha ixesha lokukhula elibandayo nomhlaba ochumileyo, ophuma kakuhle amanzi. Ubushushu buyehlisa umgangatho weentyatyambo ezingekavuleki kwaye iqabaka linokuzonakalisa.

items.key: Choose a sunny, well-drained growing position, protect establishment and plan pruning for leaf harvest.
items.english: Choose a sunny, well-drained growing position, protect establishment and plan pruning for leaf harvest.
items.draft: Khetha indawo yokukhula enelanga, ephuma kakuhle amanzi, khusela ukuqala kwesityalo kwaye ucwangcise ukunqunyulwa kwemfuno yokuvuna amagqabi.
items.backtranslation: Choose a sunny, well-draining growing place, protect establishment and plan the cutting of the [garbled: "need"/vegetable] for leaf harvest.
items.problem: Garbled: 'plan pruning for leaf harvest' became 'plan the cutting of the need for leaf harvest' (imfuno = need).
items.corrected: Khetha indawo yokukhula enelanga, ephuma kakuhle amanzi, khusela ukuqala kwesityalo kwaye ucwangcise ukuthenwa kwaso ukuze uvune amagqabi.

items.key: Provide climbing support. Tuberous roots are poisonous; children should not forage unsupervised.
items.english: Provide climbing support. Tuberous roots are poisonous; children should not forage unsupervised.
items.draft: Nika inkxaso yokunyuka. Iingcambu ezinjengetiyubha zinetyhefu; abantwana akufuneki baqokelele ukutya bengaphangelwanga.
items.backtranslation: Give climbing support. The tuber-like roots are poisonous; children must not collect food [garbled: "without being worked-for/employed" — supervision meaning lost].
items.problem: Safety condition lost: 'unsupervised' rendered with -phangela (work for wages), so 'children should not forage unsupervised' next to poisonous roots reads as 'without being employed'; the supervision condition is gone.
items.corrected: Nika inkxaso yokunyuka. Iingcambu ezinjengetiyubha zinetyhefu; abantwana akufuneki baqokelele ukutya kwasendle bengajongwanga ngumntu omdala.

items.key: SANBI records it in arid Karoo and Eastern Cape scrub, with frost and drought tolerance. It can grow in sun or semi-shade.
items.english: SANBI records it in arid Karoo and Eastern Cape scrub, with frost and drought tolerance. It can grow in sun or semi-shade.
items.draft: I-SANBI iyibhala kwi-Karoo eyomileyo nakwiintlokwana zeMpuma Koloni, inyamezela iqabaka nembalela. Ingakhula elangeni okanye emthunzini ongaphelelanga.
items.backtranslation: SANBI records it in the dry Karoo and Eastern Cape [small peaks/hills], tolerating frost and drought. It can grow in sun or part shade.
items.problem: Wrong habitat term: 'Eastern Cape scrub' became 'iintlokwana' (little heads/peaks).
items.corrected: I-SANBI iyibhala kwi-Karoo eyomileyo nakumatyholo eMpuma Koloni, inyamezela iqabaka nembalela. Ingakhula elangeni okanye emthunzini ongaphelelanga.

items.key: Seeds and unripe fruit are toxic. Keep children away from unsupervised harvesting and preparation.
items.english: Seeds and unripe fruit are toxic. Keep children away from unsupervised harvesting and preparation.
items.draft: Imbewu neziqhamo ezingekavuthi zinetyhefu. Gcina abantwana kude nokuvuna nokulungiswa okungaphangelwanga.
items.backtranslation: The seeds and unripe fruit are poisonous. Keep children away from [garbled: "unworked/unemployed"] harvesting and preparation.
items.problem: Safety condition lost: 'unsupervised harvesting and preparation' of toxic seeds/unripe fruit rendered with -phangela ('unworked/unemployed'); supervision meaning is gone.
items.corrected: Imbewu neziqhamo ezingekavuthi zinetyhefu. Gcina abantwana kude nokuvuna nokulungiselela okungajongwanga ngumntu omdala.

items.key: The food product is a tuber, not a potato-family fruit. Warm summer-rainfall cultivation with little frost is described; winter/spring flowering after leaf loss is not a dated tuber-digging calendar.
items.english: The food product is a tuber, not a potato-family fruit. Warm summer-rainfall cultivation with little frost is described; winter/spring flowering after leaf loss is not a dated tuber-digging calendar.
items.draft: Imveliso yokutya yitiyubha, hayi isiqhamo sosapho lwebhatata. Kuchazwa ukulinywa kwemvula yasehlotyeni eshushu enqabaka kancinci; ukuqhakaza kobusika/kwentwasahlobo emva kokulahlekelwa ngamagqabi akuyiyo ikhalenda enemihla yokumba iitiyubha.
items.backtranslation: The food product is the tuber, not a fruit of the sweet-potato family. Hot summer-rain cultivation with light frost is described; winter/spring flowering after leaf loss is not a dated calendar for digging tubers.
items.problem: Wrong plant family: 'potato-family fruit' became 'sweet-potato (ibhatata) family fruit'; potato (Solanaceae) fruits are the toxic comparison meant.
items.corrected: Imveliso yokutya yitiyubha, hayi isiqhamo sosapho lwetapile. Kuchazwa ukulinywa kwemvula yasehlotyeni eshushu enqabaka kancinci; ukuqhakaza kobusika/kwentwasahlobo emva kokulahlekelwa ngamagqabi akuyiyo ikhalenda enemihla yokumba iitiyubha.

items.key: use only a product currently registered for the exact crop and problem. Follow its current label for dose, protective equipment, re-entry, pre-harvest interval, storage and disposal. Never infer safety from “natural” or “organic.”
items.english: use only a product currently registered for the exact crop and problem. Follow its current label for dose, protective equipment, re-entry, pre-harvest interval, storage and disposal. Never infer safety from “natural” or “organic.”
items.draft: sebenzisa kuphela imveliso ebhaliswe ngoku kwisityalo ngqo nengxaki. Landela ilebhile yayo yangoku malunga nomlinganiselo, izixhobo zokukhusela, ukungena kwakhona, ixesha phambi kokuvuna, ukugcina nokulahla. Musa ukuthatha ukhuseleko ngokuthi “yendalo” okanye “organic.”
items.backtranslation: use only a product currently registered for the exact crop and problem. Follow its current label on dose, protective equipment, re-entry, the time before harvest, storage and disposal. Do not assume safety because of "natural" or "organic."
items.problem: Pesticide warning softened: English 'Never infer safety from natural/organic'; draft 'Musa ukuthatha ukhuseleko ngokuthi...' (don't take safety by saying...) drops 'never' and is loosely worded.
items.corrected: sebenzisa kuphela imveliso ebhaliswe ngoku kwisityalo ngqo nengxaki. Landela ilebhile yayo yangoku malunga nomlinganiselo, izixhobo zokukhusela, ukungena kwakhona, ixesha phambi kokuvuna, ukugcina nokulahla. Ungaze ucinge ukuba imveliso ikhuselekile ngenxa yokuba ithi “yendalo” okanye “organic.”

items.key:
A plan communicates decisions. Give it a clear title, revision and purpose. Show orientation, scale status, units, legend and sources. Distinguish existing features from proposed changes and unresolved information using labels or patterns as well as colour. Keep labels near the correct features without covering essential details.

Separate information when a single sheet becomes crowded. A base map, analysis overlay, proposal and phase sheet can tell different parts of the same story. Keep feature names and references consistent between them. The cost record and care plan should refer to the same items shown on the map.

Inspect the actual export at the size it will be used. Can someone read it on a phone or printed sheet? Are labels clipped? Does the legend describe things that are really present? Does decorative artwork hide a path or imply features that were never recorded? Correct the output and check again.

items.draft:
Isicwangciso sixela izigqibo. Sinike isihloko esicacileyo, uhlaziyo nenjongo. Bonisa ulwalathiso, imeko yesikali, iiyunithi, intsingiselo nemithombo. Wahlula iimpawu ezikhoyo kutshintsho olucetywayo nolwazi olungaxazululwanga usebenzisa iileyibhile okanye iipatheni kunye nombala. Gcina iileyibhile kufutshane neempawu ezichanekileyo ungagquli iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo.

Wahlula ulwazi xa iphepha elinye lixineneyo. Imephu esisiseko, ishiti yohlalutyo, isiphakamiso nephepha lenqanaba zinokubalisa amacandelo ahlukeneyo ebali elinye. Gcina amagama neencwadi zobungqina ziguquguquki phakathi kwazo. Irekhodi leendleko nesicwangciso sonophelo kufuneka zibhekisele kwizinto ezifanayo ezibonakala kwimephu.

Hlola into ethunyelwe ngaphandle ngokwenyani ngobungakanani eza kusetyenziswa ngabo. Ingaba umntu angayifunda kwifowuni okanye kwiphepha elishicilelweyo? Ingaba iileyibhile ziqhekekile? Ingaba intsingiselo ichaza izinto ezikhoyo ngokwenene? Ingaba umzobo wokuhombisa ufihla indlela okanye ubonisa iimpawu ezingazange zirekhodwe? Lungisa isiphumo uphinde ukhangele.
items.backtranslation:
The plan reports decisions. Give it a clear title, revision and purpose. Show orientation, scale status, units, legend and sources. Separate existing features from proposed changes and unresolved information using labels or patterns as well as colour. Keep labels close to the correct features without covering important details.

Separate information when one sheet is crowded. A base map, an analysis sheet, a proposal and a phase sheet can tell different parts of one story. Keep names and evidence documents CHANGING/VARYING between them. A cost record and a care plan must refer to the same items that appear on the map.

Check the exported item for real at the size it will be used. Can someone read it on a phone or a printed page? Are labels broken? Does the legend describe things that really exist? Does a decorative drawing hide a path or show features never recorded? Fix the output and check again.
items.problem: Reversal: 'Keep feature names and references consistent between them' became 'keep names and evidence documents changing/varying (ziguquguquki) between them'.

items.key:
Present four altered copies, one at a time. Each begins from the clean main pack; do not stack their errors.

| Altered practice copy | What the learner should find | Evidence-led correction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| H02 is absent; book says only 1 kg remains | Missing 8 kg harvest | Restore H02 from the supplied Day 3 weighing record; closing stock becomes 9 kg |
| PAY02 appears twice; buyer payments total R320.00 | One R60.00 payment counted twice | Retain one payment for its one reference; payments return to R260.00 and S02 still has R40.00 owed |
| MOVE01 is called a new sale | Own money mistaken for revenue | Restore linked transfer treatment; there is no new buyer or delivery supporting a sale |
| PACK01 is written as R125.00 | Decimal error of R112.50 | Copy R12.50 from the source; do not alter the receipt to agree with the entry |

Write a correction note containing the record reference, old entry, corrected entry, source used, date of correction and person checking it. In the paper exercise use a single line through the error so it remains readable. Follow the actual app's supported correction controls for real records; do not prescribe deleting a linked sale or invoice as a routine fix.

items.draft:
Bonisa iikopi ezine eziguquliweyo, enye ngexesha. Nganye iqala kwipakethe ecocekileyo ephambili; musa ukuyibeka phezu kweempazamo zazo.

| Ikopi yokuziqhelisa eguquliweyo | Into umfundi ekufanele ayifumane | Ulungiso olukhokelwa bubungqina |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I-H02 ayikho; incwadi ithi i-1 kg kuphela eseleyo | Isivuno se-8 kg esilahlekileyo | Buyisela i-H02 kwirekhodi yokupima yoSuku 3 enikeziweyo; isitokhwe sokuvala siba yi-9 kg |
| I-PAY02 ibonakala kabini; iintlawulo zabathengi zidibana nge-R320.00 | Intlawulo enye ye-R60.00 ibaliwe kabini | Gcina intlawulo enye kwisalathiso sayo esinye; iintlawulo zibuyela kwi-R260.00 yaye i-S02 isanetyala le-R40.00 |
| I-MOVE01 ibizwa ngokuba yintengiso entsha | Imali yomnini ithathwe njengengeniso | Buyisela unyango lokuhanjiswa okuxhunyiweyo; akukho mthengi okanye uhanjiso olutsha lwenzakalayo oluxhasa intengiso |
| I-PACK01 ibhalwe njenge-R125.00 | Impazamo yedesimali ye-R112.50 | Kopa i-R12.50 kumthombo; musa ukutshintsha irisithi ukuze ihambelane nengeniso |

Bhala inqaku lolungiso eliqulathe isalathiso serekhodi, ingeniso endala, ingeniso elungisiweyo, umthombo osetyenzisiweyo, umhla wolungiso nomntu olukhangelayo. Kwisiqhelo sephepha sebenzisa umgca omnye phezu kwempazamo ukuze ihlale ifundeka. Landela izilawuli zolungiso ezixhaswa yi-app yokwenyani kwiirekhodi zokwenyani; musa ukuyalela ukucinywa kwentengiso okanye i-invoyisi exhunyiweyo njengendlela eqhelekileyo yokulungisa.
items.backtranslation:
Show four altered copies, one at a time. Each starts from a clean main packet; do not put it on top of their errors.

[Table: Altered practice copy | What the learner should find | Evidence-led correction. H02 is missing; the book says only 1 kg left | A missing 8 kg harvest | Restore H02 from the given Day 3 weighing record; closing stock becomes 9 kg. PAY02 appears twice; customer payments total R320.00 | One R60.00 payment counted twice | Keep one payment at its one reference; payments go back to R260.00 and S02 still owes R40.00. MOVE01 is called a new sale | The owner's money taken as income | Restore the linked delivery treatment; no customer or new delivery occurred that supports a sale. PACK01 is recorded as R125.00 | A decimal error of R112.50 | Copy R12.50 from the source; do not change the receipt to match the entry.]

Write a correction note containing the record reference, old entry, corrected entry, source used, correction date and the person checking it. In paper practice use a single line through the error so it stays readable. Follow the correction controls supported by the real app on real records; do not instruct deleting a sale or a linked invoice as a normal correction method.
items.problem: Money meaning drift in the MOVE01 row: 'linked transfer' (owner moving own money) became 'linked delivery', and 'lwenzakalayo' (that is injured) replaced 'that happened'; 'new buyer' lost 'new'.

items.key: If loan receipts become sales revenue, link the money to its repayment obligation. If a fee is charged twice, trace whether it was withheld, paid separately or already included. If the learner chooses the unknown offer by its apparent total, restore the missing field. Collect a blank or approved redacted quote and list questions. Keep original terms and dates. Do not apply for credit, choose a lender, enter private identity details or transfer money as a lesson exercise.

If the learner chooses the unknown offer by its apparent total, restore the missing field. Collect a blank or approved redacted quote and list questions. Keep original terms and dates. items.draft: Ukuba iirisithi zemboleko ziba yingeniso yeentengiso, nxulumanisa imali nesibophelelo sayo sokubuyisela. Ukuba intlawulo ibizwa kabini, landela ukuba yabanjwa, yahlawulwa ngokwahlukeneyo okanye yayisele iqukiwe. Ukuba umfundi ukhetha isicelo esingaziwayo ngesixa saso esibonakalayo, buyisela indawo elahlekileyo. Qokelela isicelo esingenanto okanye esivunyiweyo esicinyiweyo ubhale imibuzo. Gcina imiqathango yoqobo nemihla. Musa ukufaka isicelo sekhredithi, ukukhetha umbolekisi, ukufaka iinkcukacha zesazisi zangasese okanye ukuhambisa imali njengomsebenzi wesifundo.
items.backtranslation: If loan receipts become sales income, link the money to its repayment obligation. If a payment is named twice, trace whether it was held, paid separately or already included. If the learner chooses an unknown quote/application by its visible amount, restore the missing field. Collect a blank or approved [garbled: "deleted"] quote/application and write questions. Keep the original terms and dates. Do not apply for credit, choose a lender, enter private identity details or move money as study work.
items.problem: Privacy/money term: 'approved redacted quote' became 'approved deleted application' (esicinyiweyo); redaction of personal details is lost, and 'offer/quote' became 'isicelo' (application).
items.corrected: Ukuba iirisithi zemboleko ziba yingeniso yeentengiso, nxulumanisa imali nesibophelelo sayo sokubuyisela. Ukuba intlawulo ibizwa kabini, landela ukuba yabanjwa, yahlawulwa ngokwahlukeneyo okanye yayisele iqukiwe. Ukuba umfundi ukhetha isiphakamiso sexabiso esingaziwayo ngesixa saso esibonakalayo, buyisela indawo elahlekileyo. Qokelela isiphakamiso sexabiso esingenanto okanye esivunyiweyo esifihlwe iinkcukacha zobuqu ubhale imibuzo. Gcina imiqathango yoqobo nemihla. Musa ukufaka isicelo sekhredithi, ukukhetha umbolekisi, ukufaka iinkcukacha zesazisi zangasese okanye ukuhambisa imali njengomsebenzi wesifundo.

items.key:
Place A01 across the January–February boundary. Work was completed in January at the agreed R80 charge. The invoice is dated February and the amount is unpaid at January end. Under this model, January includes the R80 cost and liability, while January cash does not change. Retain both documents and dates. Now place F01: cash leaves in January, but the whole storage service is for February. January includes a R120 prepayment asset, not a January storage cost. A real contract may need different treatment; this case supplies the timing and rights explicitly.

Show the stock bridge: opening R300 + purchases R400 − goods supplied R350 = R350 before the closing check. C01 supports a R50 loss and R300 remaining. This is a reviewed reconciliation, not an instruction to label every unexplained difference as theft or spoilage. Ask for evidence before choosing a cause or accounting treatment. Show the equipment bridge: opening R600 + purchase R300 − supplied period depreciation R60 = R840. The charge spreads cost in this model but is not a new payment and is not a tax allowance.

items.draft:
Beka i-A01 phakathi komda kaJanuwari–Februwari. Umsebenzi wagqitywa kuJanuwari ngentlawulo evunyelweneyo ye-R80. I-invoyisi inomhla kaFebruwari kwaye isixa asihlawulwanga ekupheleni kukaJanuwari. Phantsi kwale modeli, uJanuwari uquka indleko ye-R80 netyala, ngoxa imali engqo kaJanuwari ingatshintshi. Gcina amaxwebhu omabini nemihla. Ngoku beka i-F01: imali iphuma ngoJanuwari, kodwa yonke inkonzo yokugcina ngeyoFebruwari. UJanuwari uquka impahla yentlawulo yangaphambili ye-R120, hayi indleko yokugcina kaJanuwari. Ikontraka yokwenyani isenokufuna unyango olwahlukileyo; eli tyala linika ixesha namalungelo ngokucacileyo.

Bonisa ibhulorho yesitokhwe: ukuvula i-R300 + ukuthenga i-R400 − iimpahla ezinikezelweyo i-R350 = i-R350 phambi kokukhangela kokuvala. I-C01 ixhasa ilahleko ye-R50 ne-R300 esele. Oku kuvumelanisa okuhloliweyo, hayi umyalelo wokubiza yonke imahluko engachazwanga ngokuba kuyaba okanye konakele. Cela ubungqina phambi kokukhetha isizathu okanye unyango lweeakhawunti. Bonisa ibhulorho yezixhobo: ukuvula i-R600 + ukuthenga i-R300 − ukuncipha kwexabiso lexesha elinikeziweyo i-R60 = i-R840. Intlawulo isasaza indleko kule modeli kodwa asiyontlawulo intsha kwaye asiyo mvume yerhafu.

The payment/charge spreads the cost in this model but it is not a new payment and it is not tax permission.

items.key:
A small market stall buys finished goods for resale. It is a separate exercise within the farm-business pathway, not a valuation of growing crops, animals, home-grown harvests or an entire homestead. All amounts and dates are invented. The period is 1–31 January 2027. Values below are supplied carrying amounts for the exercise; they are not market quotations. No VAT or income-tax calculation is included. Equipment classification, depreciation and stock-loss treatment are supplied assumptions, not policies to copy into real accounts.

At opening: cash R1000; customers owe R200; resale stock R300; equipment R600. The business owes suppliers R300 and has no loan. Total assets R2100 less liabilities R300 leaves opening equity R1800. Equity is the owner's residual interest, not a second cash account. There are no other opening balances in this bounded model.

| Ref | Event date | Original source card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R01 | 5 Jan | Collect R200 from the opening customer balance. This older sale is not January revenue. |
| P01 | 8 Jan | Receive resale goods costing R400. Pay R250; R150 remains owed. |
| S01 | 10 Jan | Deliver an accepted credit sale of R900. Goods supplied have carrying cost R350. No receipt yet. |
| R02 | 15 Jan | Receive R600 toward S01. Link the receipt to that sale. |
| P02 | 16 Jan | Pay R200 against amounts already owed to suppliers. |
| E01 | 20 Jan | Pay R300 for a lasting tool. It qualifies as equipment in this exercise. |
| L01 | 21 Jan | Receive a R500 loan with a matching obligation. No initial fee here. |
| L02 | 24 Jan | Pay R110: R100 loan principal and R10 January interest. |
| H01 | 26 Jan | Owner takes R150 for personal use. No wage or business service is supplied. |
| A01 | 28 Jan | January transport service completed, agreed charge R80, unpaid. Invoice arrives 2 February; a signed January work record supports the amount and period. |
| F01 | 29 Jan | Pay R120 for storage supplied wholly in February. None of that service is used by 31 January. |
| U01 | 31 Jan | Pay R60 utility cost relating wholly to January. |
| C01 | 31 Jan | Approved count, valuation and reconciliation confirm closing resale stock R300 and a R50 stock loss. |
| D01 | 31 Jan | Supplied reviewed schedule gives R60 January depreciation across the equipment. It is not an extra cash payment. |
| X01 | 5 Feb | Receive the remaining R300 of S01. This is outside January cash. |

items.draft:
Isitali esincinci semarike sithenga iimpahla ezigqityiweyo ukuze zithengiswe kwakhona. Lo msebenzi ohlukileyo ngaphakathi kwendlela yokufunda yebhizinisi lefama, hayi uxabiso lwezityalo ezikhulayo, izilwanyana, izivuno ezikhuliswe ekhaya okanye yonke ikhaya. Zonke izixa nemihla ziyilisiwe. Ixesha li-1–31 kuJanuwari 2027. Amaxabiso angezantsi ngamaxabiso abhaliweyo anikiweyo kulo msebenzi; asingamaxabiso emarike. Akukho ubalo lwe-VAT okanye lwerhafu yengeniso. Ukwahlulwa kwezixhobo, ukuncipha kwexabiso nonyango lweelahleko zesitokhwe ziingcinga ezinikiweyo, hayi imigaqo-nkqubo yokukopa kwiiakhawunti zokwenyani.

Ekuvuleni: imali engqo i-R1000; abathengi batyala i-R200; isitokhwe sokuthengisa kwakhona i-R300; izixhobo i-R600. Ibhizinisi litya abathengisi i-R300 kwaye akunamboleko. Impahla epheleleyo i-R2100 kuthatyathwe amatyala i-R300 ishiya ubunini bokuvula i-R1800. Ubunini bubuyela kumnini, asiyiyo i-akhawunti yesibini yemali. Akukho zinye iibhalansi zokuvula kulo mzekelo ophetheke.

| Isalathiso | Umhla wesiganeko | Ikhadi lomthombo loqobo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R01 | 5 Jan | Qokelela i-R200 kwibhalansi yomthengi yokuvula. Le ntengiso indala asingeniso kaJanuwari. |
| P01 | 8 Jan | Amkela iimpahla zokuthengisa kwakhona ezixabisa i-R400. Hlawula i-R250; i-R150 isafuneka. |
| S01 | 10 Jan | Hambisa intengiso yetyala eyamkelweyo ye-R900. Iimpahla ezinikezelweyo zinexabiso elibhaliweyo le-R350. Akukho risithi okwangoku. |
| R02 | 15 Jan | Amkela i-R600 kwi-S01. Nxulumanisa irisithi nentengiso leyo. |
| P02 | 16 Jan | Hlawula i-R200 ngokuchasene nezixa esele zifunwa ngabathengisi. |
| E01 | 20 Jan | Hlawula i-R300 ngesixhobo esihlala ixesha elide. Siyafaneleka njengesixhobo kulo msebenzi. |
| L01 | 21 Jan | Amkela imboleko ye-R500 enesibophelelo esihambelanayo. Akukho ntlawulo yokuqala apha. |
| L02 | 24 Jan | Hlawula i-R110: i-R100 yesixa seboleko esiphambili ne-R10 yenzala kaJanuwari. |
| H01 | 26 Jan | Umnini uthatha i-R150 ukuze asebenzise ngobuqu. Akukho mvuzo okanye inkonzo yebhizinisi enikezelwayo. |
| A01 | 28 Jan | Inkonzo yokuthuthwa kukaJanuwari igqityiwe, intlawulo evunyelweneyo i-R80, ayihlawulwanga. I-invoyisi ifika ngomhla wesi-2 kuFebruwari; irekhodi lomsebenzi lika-Januwari elisayiniweyo lixhasa isixa nexesha. |
| F01 | 29 Jan | Hlawula i-R120 yenkonzo yokugcina enikezelwa ngokupheleleyo ngoFebruwari. Akukho nxalenye yaloo nkonzo isetyenzisiweyo ngomhla wama-31 kuJanuwari. |
| U01 | 31 Jan | Hlawula i-R60 yendleko yenkonzo enxulumene ngokupheleleyo noJanuwari. |
| C01 | 31 Jan | Ukubala okuvunyiweyo, ixabiso nokuvumelanisa kuqinisekisa isitokhwe sokuthengisa kwakhona sokuvala i-R300 nelahleko yesitokhwe ye-R50. |
| D01 | 31 Jan | Uluhlu oluhlolisisiweyo olunikeziweyo lunika ukuncipha kwexabiso kukaJanuwari i-R60 kuzo zonke izixhobo. Asiyontlawulo yemali eyongezelelweyo. |
| X01 | 5 Feb | Amkela i-R300 esele ye-S01. Oku kungaphandle kwemali engqo kaJanuwari. |

items.key: If a forecast is relabelled as actual, return to the source status. If an application pays the bill in the model, remove it and restore the gap. If a claim rests on the map's appearance, ask for the appropriate underlying agreement, measurement or record. A legitimate answer may be “not ready to commit; obtain this evidence”. It is not a failure to preserve uncertainty.
items.english: If a forecast is relabelled as actual, return to the source status. If an application pays the bill in the model, remove it and restore the gap. If a claim rests on the map's appearance, ask for the appropriate underlying agreement, measurement or record. A legitimate answer may be “not ready to commit; obtain this evidence”. It is not a failure to preserve uncertainty.
items.draft: Ukuba uqikelelo luphinda lubizwe ngokuba kwenzekile, buyela kwimeko yomthombo. Ukuba isicelo sihlawula ibhili kwimodeli, sisuse, ubuyise isikhewu. Ukuba ibango lixhomekeke ekubonakaleni kwemephu, cela isivumelwano esifanelekileyo esingaphantsi, ukulinganisa okanye irekhodi. Impendulo esemthethweni inokuba “ayikalungeli ukuzibophelela; fumana obu bungqina”. Asiyiso ukusilela ukugcina ukungaqiniseki.
items.backtranslation: If an estimate is again called something that happened, go back to the source state. If a quote/application pays a bill in the model, remove it and restore the gap. If a claim depends on how the map looks, ask for a suitable [garbled: "lower"] agreement, measurement or record. A legitimate answer may be "not yet ready to commit; get this evidence". It is not failing to keep uncertainty [ambiguous].
items.problem: Calque: 'underlying agreement' became 'esingaphantsi' (a lower agreement), which does not make sense.
items.corrected: Ukuba uqikelelo luphinda lubizwe ngokuba kwenzekile, buyela kwimeko yomthombo. Ukuba isicelo sihlawula ibhili kwimodeli, sisuse, ubuyise isikhewu. Ukuba ibango lixhomekeke ekubonakaleni kwemephu, cela isivumelwano esifanelekileyo esisisiseko sebango, umlinganiselo okanye irekhodi. Impendulo esemthethweni inokuba “ayikalungeli ukuzibophelela; fumana obu bungqina”. Asiyiso ukusilela ukugcina ukungaqiniseki.

items.key: Trace every bridge step back to its source. Ask why the invoice and its two receipts are not three sales, and why the owner contribution does not increase product revenue. Keep January and February windows visible. If a learner changes the plan quantity to 36, restore the original 40 before comparing. Ask for a reasoned next action such as confirming quality/demand and payment terms, checking current quotes, and fitting work to available hours. The actual R11 and 36 kg inform an enquiry; they do not guarantee next month's price or sales.
items.english: Trace every bridge step back to its source. Ask why the invoice and its two receipts are not three sales, and why the owner contribution does not increase product revenue. Keep January and February windows visible. If a learner changes the plan quantity to 36, restore the original 40 before comparing. Ask for a reasoned next action such as confirming quality/demand and payment terms, checking current quotes, and fitting work to available hours. The actual R11 and 36 kg inform an enquiry; they do not guarantee next month's price or sales.
items.draft: Landela inyathelo ngalinye lebhulorho ubuyele kumthombo walo. Buza ukuba kutheni i-invoyisi neerisithi zayo ezimbini zingeyiyo intengiso ezintathu, nokuba kutheni igalelo lomnini lingakhuli ingeniso yemveliso. Gcina amafestile kaJanuwari noFebruwari ebonakala. Ukuba umfundi utshintsha ubungakanani besicwangciso buye ku-36, buyisela i-40 yoqobo phambi kokuthelekisa. Cela inyathelo elilandelayo elinesizathu elifana nokuqinisekisa umgangatho/imfuno neemeko zentlawulo, ukukhangela amaxabiso angoku, nokulungelelanisa umsebenzi neeyure ezikhoyo. I-R11 ye-36 kg yokwenyani ixelela isicelo; ayiqinisekisi ixabiso okanye iintengiso zenyanga ezayo.
items.backtranslation: Follow each step of the bridge back to its source. Ask why the invoice and its two receipts are not three sales, and why the owner's contribution does not grow product income. Keep the January and February windows visible. If the learner changes the plan size to 36, restore the original 40 before comparing. Ask for a reasoned next step such as confirming quality/need and payment conditions, checking current prices, and fitting the work to available hours. The R11 for the actual 36 kg informs the quote/application; it does not confirm the price or next month's sales.
items.problem: Quantity/price relation changed: 'The actual R11 and 36 kg inform an enquiry' became 'R11 for the actual 36 kg' (R11 total for 36 kg), and 'enquiry' became 'application'.
items.corrected: Landela inyathelo ngalinye lebhulorho ubuyele kumthombo walo. Buza ukuba kutheni i-invoyisi neerisithi zayo ezimbini zingeyiyo intengiso ezintathu, nokuba kutheni igalelo lomnini lingakhuli ingeniso yemveliso. Gcina amafestile kaJanuwari noFebruwari ebonakala. Ukuba umfundi utshintsha ubungakanani besicwangciso buye ku-36, buyisela i-40 yoqobo phambi kokuthelekisa. Cela inyathelo elilandelayo elinesizathu elifana nokuqinisekisa umgangatho/imfuno neemeko zentlawulo, ukukhangela amaxabiso angoku, nokulungelelanisa umsebenzi neeyure ezikhoyo. I-R11 yokwenyani ne-36 kg yokwenyani zinika ulwazi kuphando; aziqinisekisi ixabiso okanye iintengiso zenyanga ezayo.

items.key: Name the missing evidence, a suitable way to obtain it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help.
items.english: Name the missing evidence, a suitable way to obtain it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help.
items.draft: Tsho ubungqina obulahlekileyo, indlela ephucukileyo yokubufumana, ukuba ngubani onokunceda nokuba sesiphi isigqibo esixhomekeke kubo. Gcina umsebenzi ongakhuselekanga okanye okhethekileyo uncedo olufanelekileyo.
items.backtranslation: State the missing evidence, a better way to get it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work [missing verb/preposition: "suitable help"].
items.problem: Safety instruction garbled: 'Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help' lost 'for', reading as 'keep unsafe work [as] suitable help'; the leave-it-to-qualified-help meaning is gone.
items.corrected: Tsho ubungqina obulahlekileyo, indlela ephucukileyo yokubufumana, ukuba ngubani onokunceda nokuba sesiphi isigqibo esixhomekeke kubo. Umsebenzi ongakhuselekanga okanye okhethekileyo wushiyele uncedo olufanelekileyo.

items.key: . High humidity — select disease-resistant varieties and maximise airflow.

items.draft: . Umswakama ophezulu — khetha iindidi ezinganyangekiyo zizifo uvule indlela yomoya ngokubanzi.
items.backtranslation: . High humidity — choose varieties [garbled: "that cannot be cured by diseases"] and open the airflow widely.

items.corrected: . Umswakama ophezulu — khetha iindidi ezimelana nezifo uze uvulele umoya uhambe kakuhle kangangoko.

items.key: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
items.english: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
items.draft: Tyala emva kokuba ingozi yeqabaka idlulile: kuNovemba ukuya phakathi kukaJanyuwari kwiindawo ezineqabaka, okanye kuMatshi-Epreli kwiindawo ezingenaqabaka. Shiya iipodi zimthuphe zize zome phambi kokuzixobula nokuzigcina.
items.backtranslation: Plant after frost danger has passed: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave the pods to [garbled "zimthuphe" ~ripen] and dry before shelling and storing them.
items.problem: Non-word: 'zimthuphe' for 'leave pods to yellow' before shelling and storing; the ripeness cue is lost.
items.corrected: Tyala emva kokuba ingozi yeqabaka idlulile: kuNovemba ukuya phakathi kukaJanyuwari kwiindawo ezineqabaka, okanye kuMatshi-Epreli kwiindawo ezingenaqabaka. Shiya iipodi zibe mthubi zize zome phambi kokuzixobula nokuzigcina.
